<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->
With plain data parallelism, `attn_dp_rank` is zero on every replica. The sender currently uses this value to validate `follow_bootstrap_room` routing and register each request's prefill DP rank. As a result, a request handled by replica 1 can be rejected or registered as belonging to replica 0, causing the decode side to contact the wrong prefill worker.

Use the rank of the active DP dimension for these operations: `system_dp_rank` when `system_dp_size > 1`, otherwise `attn_dp_rank`. This matches the bootstrap server's existing topology indexing.

Revisits the fix proposed in [#29730](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/29730), associated with [#29725](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/29725). That PR was closed automatically after 91 days without updates and was not merged. This change revalidates the issue against the current working branch and adapts the existing regression test.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->
- Add `CommonKVManager.effective_dp_rank` as a property so both sender paths use the same selection rule. Keep the original system-DP and attention-DP topology fields intact.
- Use the effective rank in the `follow_bootstrap_room` conflict check and its error message. Correctly routed plain-DP requests are accepted, while genuine routing conflicts remain rejected.
- Use the effective rank in the `/register_dp_rank` payload so decode workers resolve the actual prefill replica.
- Update the sender registration test to represent both plain DP and DP attention. The previous fixture assigned `attn_dp_rank=dp_rank`, masking the plain-DP case where replica 1 has `system_dp_rank=1` but `attn_dp_rank=0`. The updated fixture exercises the real manager property and sender code, covering round-robin routing, bootstrap-room routing, forced queries, and explicit prefill-rank hints.

## Accuracy Tests

- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

@@ -1391,6 +1391,11 @@ def _sync_bootstrap_port_across_nodes(self, local_port: int) -> int:
             )
         return synced_port
 
+    @property
+    def effective_dp_rank(self) -> int:
+        """The DP index used by bootstrap routing for this worker."""
+        return self.system_dp_rank if self.system_dp_size > 1 else self.attn_dp_rank
+
     def register_to_bootstrap(self):
         """Register prefill server info to bootstrap server via HTTP PUT."""
         if self.dist_init_addr:
@@ -1978,14 +1983,14 @@ def __init__(
             ):
                 self._register_prefill_dp_rank()
             elif (
-                self.kv_mgr.attn_dp_rank
+                self.kv_mgr.effective_dp_rank
                 != self.bootstrap_room % get_parallel().num_dp_ranks
             ):
                 # follow_bootstrap_room was overridden by external routed_dp_rank
                 self.kv_mgr.record_failure(
                     self.bootstrap_room,
                     f"follow_bootstrap_room conflict: dispatched to dp_rank "
-                    f"{self.kv_mgr.attn_dp_rank} but bootstrap_room "
+                    f"{self.kv_mgr.effective_dp_rank} but bootstrap_room "
                     f"{self.bootstrap_room} implies dp_rank "
                     f"{self.bootstrap_room % get_parallel().num_dp_ranks}. "
                     f"Set SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_FORCE_QUERY_PREFILL_DP_RANK=1 "
@@ -1999,7 +2004,7 @@ def _register_prefill_dp_rank(self):
         url = f"http://{self.bootstrap_server_url}/register_dp_rank"
         payload = {
             "bootstrap_room": self.bootstrap_room,
-            "dp_rank": self.kv_mgr.attn_dp_rank,
+            "dp_rank": self.kv_mgr.effective_dp_rank,
         }
         try:
             response = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=5)

@@ -27,17 +27,39 @@ def setUp(self):
         self.addCleanup(override.restore)
 
     def test_sender_dp_rank_registration(self):
+        from itertools import product
+
         from sglang.srt.disaggregation.base.conn import KVPoll
-        from sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.conn import CommonKVSender
-
-        for force_query in (False, True):
-            for dp_rank in (0, 1):
-                with self.subTest(force_query=force_query, dp_rank=dp_rank):
-                    mgr = MagicMock(
-                        is_dummy_cp_rank=False,
-                        attn_dp_rank=dp_rank,
-                        deferred_bootstrap=None,
-                    )
+        from sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.conn import (
+            CommonKVManager,
+            CommonKVSender,
+        )
+
+        for system_dp_size, attn_dp_size in ((4, 1), (1, 4)):
+            for method, force_query, dp_rank, room, explicit_rank in product(
+                ("follow_bootstrap_room", "round_robin"),
+                (False, True),
+                (0, 1),
+                (4, 5),
+                (False, True),
+            ):
+                with self.subTest(
+                    system_dp_size=system_dp_size,
+                    attn_dp_size=attn_dp_size,
+                    method=method,
+                    force_query=force_query,
+                    dp_rank=dp_rank,
+                    room=room,
+                    explicit_rank=explicit_rank,
+                ):
+                    mgr = CommonKVManager.__new__(CommonKVManager)
+                    mgr.is_dummy_cp_rank = False
+                    mgr.deferred_bootstrap = None
+                    mgr.system_dp_size = system_dp_size
+                    mgr.system_dp_rank = dp_rank if system_dp_size > 1 else 0
+                    mgr.attn_dp_rank = dp_rank if attn_dp_size > 1 else 0
+                    mgr.update_status = MagicMock()
+                    mgr.record_failure = MagicMock()
                     sender = MagicMock(spec=CommonKVSender)
                     sender._register_prefill_dp_rank = (
                         CommonKVSender._register_prefill_dp_rank.__get__(sender)
@@ -47,7 +69,10 @@ def test_sender_dp_rank_registration(self):
                             "sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.conn.requests.post"
                         ) as mock_post,
                         get_context().override_server_args(
-                            dp_size=4, load_balance_method="follow_bootstrap_room"
+                            dp_size=system_dp_size,
+                            attn_dp_size=attn_dp_size,
+                            tp_size=attn_dp_size,
+                            load_balance_method=method,
                         ),
                         envs.SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_FORCE_QUERY_PREFILL_DP_RANK.override(
                             force_query
@@ -58,25 +83,31 @@ def test_sender_dp_rank_registration(self):
                             sender,
                             mgr=mgr,
                             bootstrap_addr="127.0.0.1:8765",
-                            bootstrap_room=4,
+                            bootstrap_room=room,
+                            req_has_disagg_prefill_dp_rank=explicit_rank,
                         )
 
+                    register = not explicit_rank and (
+                        method != "follow_bootstrap_room" or force_query
+                    )
                     self.assertEqual(
                         mock_post.call_args_list,
                         [
                             call(
                                 "http://127.0.0.1:8765/register_dp_rank",
-                                json={"bootstrap_room": 4, "dp_rank": dp_rank},
+                                json={"bootstrap_room": room, "dp_rank": dp_rank},
                                 timeout=5,
                             )
                         ]
-                        if force_query
+                        if register
                         else [],
                     )
-                    conflict = not force_query and dp_rank != 0
+                    conflict = (
+                        not explicit_rank and not register and room % 4 != dp_rank
+                    )
                     self.assertEqual(mgr.record_failure.call_count, int(conflict))
                     mgr.update_status.assert_called_with(
-                        4, KVPoll.Failed if conflict else KVPoll.Bootstrapping
+                        room, KVPoll.Failed if conflict else KVPoll.Bootstrapping
                     )
 
     @patch("sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.conn.time")
